Two photographs of 1200 First Avenue, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 1200 First Avenue reads: Investment. Corner location one block from downtown Central Ave.

brief: Two-storey frame commercial building of about 1910 on a street corner: a shop on the ground floor with big display windows and a corner door, flats above under a low gabled roof, and a long side wall with a painted sign; a residential street continues behind. Record gap: 2 photos.

floors: W W W W W W
facade.notes: (Middletown appraisal) 1200 First Ave (1910): a long two-storey frame building on a corner with a restaurant ('MURPHY'S RESTAURANT' sign, 'LUNCH') in a storefront across the ground floor, flats above; a brick street, a stop sign, a Coca-Cola sign

why.note: the neighbourhood corner restaurant with flats above
